## Summary

Describe the problem and change.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` passes on macOS.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behaviour without controlling a real meeting.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated where needed.
- [ ] No credentials, personal paths, meeting content, or unredacted logs included.

## Meeting-control safety

Explain any impact on state detection, permission scope, command routing,
confirmation, or retries. If manually tested, use a private meeting and state
what was observed versus what remains untested. Do not attach live meeting
screenshots.
